title: Horn-Nose Dino Rubber Band Popper
description: A cartoon horned dinosaur toy that launches rubber bands: hook a band on the nose horn, stretch it to the back post, then slip it off the post to pop it forward. Chunky dino shape, no grip or trigger - clearly a toy.
use: Indoor toy for paper targets or cups only. Never aim at people or animals; wear eye protection; adult supervision for younger children.
material: PLA/PETG 0.2 mm, 3 perimeters, 15% infill. Use standard thin office rubber bands (about 60-80 mm).
